what: Kimco Realty owns open-air shopping centres across the United States, most of them anchored by a supermarket. Tenants are everyday retailers rather than department stores.
customers: Supermarkets, pharmacies, discount retailers, restaurants and service businesses renting space.
moat: Grocery-anchored centres in dense suburban locations, which draw weekly visits regardless of online shopping and where new retail development is rare.
risks: Retailer bankruptcies leave vacant anchor space
Rising interest rates raise refinancing costs for a landlord
opportunities: Operating margin of 36% with occupancy near record levels
Very little new open-air retail is being built, so supply is tight
A dividend yield above 4% backed by lease income
watch: Occupancy, leasing spreads on renewals, and same-property net operating income.
